narrative.headline: 2020 Subaru Outback: windshield and wiper complaints lead by far
narrative.summary: Owners filed 889 complaints with NHTSA. Visibility/Wiper is the most reported area at 35%, followed by the electrical system (29%). No fires, injuries, or deaths are reported in any area. Crashes are reported across a few areas, most in forward collision avoidance (4) and the electrical system (3).
